name: 吳岳錚
objective:
網路與多媒體課程的目的在介紹網路環境中常用的軟體如：Netscape、Internet Explorer、Email、BBS、Gopher、FTP、Telnet… 等。以及多媒體在處理文件、聲音、影像、圖片等資料所應用的各種軟硬體及技術，包括：1. 基本語音處理技術；2. 基本影像處理技術；3. 多媒體硬體介紹；4. 多媒體軟體介紹。
The Network and Multimedia course is to introduce the software most used in internet, such as: Netscape, Internet Explorer, Email, BBS, Gopher, FTP, Telnet, and so on. And how does multimedia process the documents, audio, video, graph, and picture data. This course will also focuses on the following topics: 1. Basic audio information processing techniques. 2. Basic video information processing techniques. 3. Multimedia hardware introduction. 4. Multimedia software introduction.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL / 專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
